title: 2008 HMMT February Team Round 1 Problem 6
statement: Construct a set of \(2^{d} d\)-dimensional lattice points so that for any two chosen points \(A, B\), the line segment \(A B\) does not pass through any other lattice point.

solutions.text: The simplest example is the set of \(2^{d}\) points of the form \(\left(a_{1}, a_{2}, \ldots, a_{d}\right)\), where \(a_{k} \in\{0,1\}\) for each \(k\). This is the set of vertices of a \(d\)-dimensional cube.
